newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks see-saw, end 1.24 pct up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks see-saw, end 1.24 pct up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before ending above 1,900 points on Tuesday. Dealers said short-covering near the close helped the index recover losses in early trade due to settlement day profit-taking.
They said major investors booked profits early on but retail investors and speculators then came in to cover short positions.
"The correction is not over yet, but a few blue chips have gone short," dealer Hina Akhlaq of ING Baring Securities said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 23.40 points, or 1.24 percent, to close at 1,911.04 at 0907 GMT after touching 1,855.11 in early trade.
Losers led gainers 192 to 35. Hub Power rose 0.90 rupees to 55.40 rupees and PTCL (A) 1.80 to 38.40.
